jd_text:
FINMECHANICS INDIA PVT. LTD.
========================================================================
====
FIELD: Job designation
========================================================================
====
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------Associate Forward Deployed Engineer
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------========================================================================
====
FIELD: Job Description
========================================================================
====
Role: Engineer spending a lot of time with financial institution practitioners, shipping solutions
that run in production facilitating price discovery, trade execution, limit checks, risk/exposure
calculations, workflows, settlements, documents, accounting.
Location: Mumbai Client Sites and Office. Occasional client travel to Asia Pacific, the Middle
East, UK and Europe.
One works with: Traders, Risk Managers, Operations, Finance Professionals and a senior FDE
mentor from day one.
One will learn: Financial Markets, Instruments, Risk Management from first principles,
technology platforms, full stack development, applied AI on real problems.
Where it leads: Owning client engagements, becoming a subject matter expert, or core
platform engineer within 3-5 years.
ABOUT FINMECHANICS
For decades, our industry has relied on large, expensive platforms that address real business
needs but are often outdated by the time they are implemented. Once embedded within a
bank's architecture, these platforms become increasingly costly and difficult to replace.
Our product journey started in the aftermath of the Global Financial Crisis. Our ambition was not
to build another platform but to help our clients navigate new market realities, respond to a
regulatory tsunami, and restore return on equity.
Working alongside our clients, we developed a new generation of solutions to tackle these
challenges. These platforms are serving 45 financial institutions around the world.
The facts:
- Founded in 2007, headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Sydney, Singapore, Mumbai,
Dubai, Zurich, Amsterdam, London, Vancouver.

- Our clients are spread across 11 countries, 5 continents, including ANZ, DBS, Kotak, Federal,
Axis, CCIL, etc.
- 105 people, of whom 50+ are in Mumbai. Small by design.
- Profitable and revenue-funded since inception. No external investors, no runway to worry
about.
WHAT A FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER (FDE) IS
A product engineer at a typical software company owns a single capability and rarely meets the
people who use it. An FDE is the inverse: you own many capabilities and work very closely with
people from the financial institutions. Your client will share problems with you that you will
understand, potentially build/enhance solutions for and deliver. You learn their business well
enough to challenge them on it, and you make the platform do what they need. This is not a
pure development job, and it is not pure consulting either. A consultant writes a
recommendation and leaves. You deliver solutions that runs on the client's infrastructure, in
production, making the client stronger - and you are there months later making it better and
solving more problems.
========================================================================
========
FIELD: Requirements
========================================================================
========
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------NO PREREQUISITES IN FINANCE OR IN ANY PARTICULAR TECHNOLOGY.
We hire across disciplines. You should, however, be passionate about technology and keen to
solve client problems.
What we screen for:
- Strong mathematical intuition and clean logical thinking. This matters far more to us than any
specific coursework.
- Solid programming fundamentals in any language.
- Clear written and spoken communication. At times, you will be explaining technical things to
non-technical people and functional things to technology personnel.
- Ownership of an outcome rather than a task.
- Curiosity about why a business works the way it does, not just what to build.
- Comfort with ambiguity, and with being the most junior person in a room full of experts. Easiest
path to becoming senior fast.
